runs.note: Correction - profile summaries. A member summary used an incorrect pronoun, reported by the representative's office. The summary was corrected. Root cause: the scoring engine inferred gender from names when writing summaries. The engine now writes every member summary without gendered pronouns, and all 100 existing summaries were reviewed and rewritten. No scores were affected.
